title: Return to Sender

make_clear: The courier is taking a parcel to the lobby.
Its delivered status contradicts her experience.
Her attempt to cancel and stop the lift fails.
The sealed floor contains a figure who wants her rather than the parcel.

voice_cast_plan.status: Planned roles only; no new voice has been selected, synthesized or approved.

narrator.direction: Calm, clear storyteller. Establish the goal and connect cause to consequence. Controlled concern without acting as the frightened courier. Do not reveal hidden motives early.

courier.direction: A different recognizable voice. Start uncertain, become frustrated, then breathless and scared. Speak to dispatch or the figure with a concrete intention. Fear grows; avoid constant shouting.

dispatcher.direction: A third brief voice if the figure speaks. Quiet and unhurried. Answer her refusal directly; keep its face and larger purpose unknown.

narration.speaker: narrator
narration.text: The label said delivered. She hadn't handed it to anyone.

phrases.text: She hadn't handed it to anyone.

narration.speaker: narrator
narration.text: She was supposed to leave it in the lobby.

narration.speaker: narrator
narration.text: No answer. And the lift was speeding up.

phrases.text: And the lift was speeding up.

narration.speaker: courier
narration.text: Cancel it. I'm taking it back.

narration.speaker: narrator
narration.text: It passed the lobby. The next floor was sealed.

narration.speaker: narrator
narration.text: Someone was waiting. She stepped back.

narration.speaker: courier
narration.text: I'm not giving you the parcel.

direction: Narrator gives essential context; courier expresses intention and rising fear; figure supplies the final reversal. Leave the opening doors speech-free from 29 to 34 seconds. A viewer should understand the present danger while wondering about the larger mystery.
timing_status: Planned cue windows only. Speech duration, separate voice casting, captions and mouth-envelope timing have not been generated or verified. Edit wording or windows rather than truncate speech.
integration_status: No entry point selects this draft. Current previews still use v4 and one temporary voice; the proposed distinct cast is not implemented by these speaker labels.
checkpoint_policy: Writing review only; do not change story memory or activate production.
automation_policy: No new synthesis, renders, uploads, scheduling, paid services, commits or pushes.
